## Clinics — the weak types

Built from the questions she got wrong on the mocks. Each clinic is **exam-standard questions only** — no
easy warm-ups — so she meets the pattern again and again and learns to **recall the method the moment she
sees the question**. The *wrong-questions booklet* is separate: it is her own six mistakes, done properly.

**✅ 이미 수업에서 다룬 것** — covered in lessons so far. Keep these for revision and homework.
